openQuestions.question: The source's relationships list (ch07/26/36) gives AuditEntry only ONE association, to BookingRequest, even though ch26 says audit entries cover booking, decision, invoice AND inspection events -- one FK cannot cover four audited entity types, and a hard association from a shared Common-layer audit module back into feature modules would also be a layer-direction violation (architecture-blueprint.md Step 2/7b).
openQuestions.answer: Architecture decision (Stage 3): dropped the literal AuditEntry_BookingRequest association; AuditEntry stays a generic Common-layer log keyed by EntityName (already in the source's own attribute table) plus a new RelatedReference text attribute holding the audited record's natural key. Every module's status-changing microflow calls the shared SUB_AuditEntry_Log with these values -- no cross-module association, no upward-pointing arrow from Common.
